purpose: Teach: 河上/金田/稲本/厚木/江崎/宇野/久留米/青葉

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 河上部長の歓迎会を準備しましょう
lines.en: Let's get the welcome reception for Manager Kawakami organized.
lines.style: Efficient, forward-moving tone. Decisive opening. Business-like but not cold—the warmth of someone who keeps things running smoothly. Even pace, no pause for questions.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。金田課長の引き継ぎ書を確認します
lines.en: Yes. I'll review Manager Kaneda's handover notes.
lines.style: Attentive and ready. Slight nod in the voice—acknowledging and committing in the same breath. Calm, steady rhythm. The tone of someone who knows their role and settles into it.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 稲本技術主任のプロジェクト進捗を共有しましょう
lines.en: Let's share the project progress from Inamoto, our tech lead.
lines.style: Purposeful directive. Slight lift on the opening verb—not a question, a suggestion that's already decided. Clear, measured delivery. Eyes on the next step.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。厚木工場の月次報告を確認します
lines.en: Yes. I'll check the Atsuki factory's monthly report.
lines.style: Confirming and moving on. Businesslike, no hesitation. The automatic competence of someone in flow with their work. Brief, efficient, slightly compressed for momentum.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 江崎系列とのキャンペーンを企画しましょう
lines.en: Let's plan the campaign with the Ezaki group.
lines.style: Clear direction with a touch of anticipation. Firm but not harsh—the tone of someone coordinating partners. Steady pace, slight emphasis on 'plan' to signal this is actionable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。宇野広報の月次企画書を確認します
lines.en: Yes. I'll review Uno's monthly PR proposal.
lines.style: Straightforward acknowledgment. Minimal but present—the efficiency of a team in sync. Neutral, professional tone. Slightly clipped rhythm to keep momentum.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 久留米市の支店長会議を予定しましょう
lines.en: Let's schedule the branch managers' meeting in Kurume.
lines.style: Directive with slight deliberation—this one carries weight. Calm, authoritative opening. Measured pace. The tone of someone who knows this meeting matters and is making sure it happens.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。青葉キャンパスの研究員と打ち合わせします
lines.en: Yes. I'll touch base with the researchers at Aoba Campus.
lines.style: Final confirmation with closure. Warm undertone—wrapping up the list. Slightly softer landing than the previous lines. Light, almost conversational within the professional frame.
